messages:
sam: Kicking off FinSafe POC — they require EU-only data residency, SAML SSO, SOC2 questionnaire answered and a BYOK option. Need: sub-processor list filtered to EU, KMS region mapping, and a rough pricing delta for geo-pin vs hosted. Who can own ops/presales?

katie: assigning presales. @ryan can you confirm which EU regions we can guarantee for a pinned tenant? also send security Q answers we can drop in the SQ.

ryan: We can host pinned tenants in eu-west-1 and eu-north-1. For Hosted API there is an EU control plane but some optional sub-processors (analytics, monitoring) default to US. For Dedicated/Private we can keep all infra in-region and support VPC + tenant pinning. BYOK: supported for Private/Dedicated via customer-managed KMS; hosted BYOK is limited (we can discuss a scoped exception for POC).

maria: Client insists on a sub-processor CSV that shows only EU entities (no US touch). Do we have an export I can send to Legal? They want it before the next exec call.

ryan: There is an export on Confluence (internal): https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/x/SubprocList — it has region flags. TL;DR: storage and logging can be EU-only for Dedicated, but hosted default pipelines include an analytics sink in us-central; we can opt-out for the POC.

sec-bot: Automated Security note: FinSafe_SQ has 6 unanswered items: subprocessor locations, KMS BYOK flow, audit logs retention, SOC2 addendum copy, SAML metadata exchange, data erasure process. Create ticket SF-1234 to track.

katie: @sam please attach the customer's SAML metadata and their filled parts of the SQ. I'll start drafting standard responses and escalate anything non-standard.

sam: Uploaded SAML metadata and the customer's SQ link to thread. Also asked for rough pricing: EU-pin + BYOK + Dedicated capacity for ~50M tokens/month. Need a very rough delta to include in the commercial.

ops-bot: Back-of-envelope numbers: Dedicated EU reserved pool (1x medium GPU pool) ~ +$6,500/mo; BYOK integration & KMS ops onboarding ~ +$1,200 one-time; cross-region replication/egress & strict residency adds ~+12% on usage costs. These are estimates — will refine after infra sizing.

maria: Can we offer a short transient Dedicated POC (4 weeks) so they can validate data path + SSO? Need timeline and ops owner to commit.

ryan: We can spin a transient Dedicated POC in eu-west-1 in ~3 business days after capacity sign-off. Example infra command I'd run for devs: `infra create-poc --region eu-west-1 --pin-tenant finsafe --ttl 28d` — requires quota + KMS key ARN if BYOK.

katie: Also legal wants the subprocessor attestation note. If we supply the EU-only subproc CSV and BYOK architecture diagram, that usually clears legal / procurement for POCs.

sam: Owners for next steps: @katie presales (SQ + commercial), @ryan infra (POC spin + KMS), @maria legal (subproc attestation). I'll tell the customer we can target a 3-5 day turn for POC spin and provide the costing sketch. :thumbsup:

maria: On it — I'll kick the attestation and ping procurement. Will update SF-1234 and drop the EU-only CSV into the ticket. :white_check_mark:
